title: ResultReference resolver uses independent RFC oracles in tests
description: resolve_args implementation (lib.rs:370-425) correctly implements RFC 8620 §9 and RFC 6901 JSON Pointer semantics. Test suite (lines 873-1222) uses RFC examples as oracles, not circular validation. Tests cover edge cases: missing paths, array OOB, non-object args, invalid JSON refs. Error messages cite the path that failed, aiding debugging.
